reviewer_basis: Only the six supplied files; no code run; all values recomputed by hand. models_1al.py, 1al and F-LOG not supplied: claims depending on them are marked unverifiable.
spec_fidelity_note: Every computation matches the docstring. The non-numeric divergences are listed in spec_divergences; none changes a number.
spec_divergences: D-a: class precedence undefined; code gives VACUOUS precedence, so VACUOUS variables appear inside minimal signatures (k REV-TYPE ADOPT; x RAISE/SUPERSEDE MF; r ASSIGN-ID MF)
D-b: MODEL-INADEQUATE/UNCONSTRAINED are listed as per-variable classes but emitted only as op-level statuses
D-c: 'minimal distinguishing situation' not implemented; the first non-bisimilar pair in BFS order is returned (here de facto the shallowest)

D-d: output uses the shorthand FORMAL-REQUIRED / MODEL-COND-REDUNDANT instead of the mandated 'under model M and the tested transition semantics' phrasing; BEHAVIOUR-RELEVANT is undefined in the docstring
D-e: 'opposite outcomes' undefined for the 3-valued outcome; NOT-IN-FORCE is treated as not-performed
D-f: r2 is a post-freeze change (disclosed); its basis in 1al is unverifiable
D-g: the name M3 is used both for the global operation model and for the m3_check LTS
r2_fix_note: Conditional: faithful only if 1al used operation-name labels, which is unverifiable here. The refinement logic is correct. PROVEN not to change any family class: op-name labels are a relabelling, so the full-label partition refines the op-name one (151 >= 80). The BEHAVIOUR-RELEVANT counterexamples are distinguished under the coarser labels, and the MODEL-COND-REDUNDANT verdicts are vacuous (no pair exists) regardless of labels. Guard sections of r1 and r2 are identical; the r1 variant is reproduced exactly.
